mapper.delete: delete from favorite where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: select * from favorite where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId}

select f.*, p.product_name, p.image_url, p.price, u.username as seller_name from favorite f left join product p on f.product_id = p.product_id left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id where f.user_id = #{userId} order by f.favorite_time desc
